clue.text: Disclaimer: hesitate about one

indicators.note: the word for hesitate wraps around the one, so 'about' signals containment

parts.note: to waver is to hesitate or be indecisive
the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A legal disclaimer that tells someone to pause over a single point.
explanation.definitionFit: A waiver is a written statement giving up a right or claim, which is a kind of formal disclaimer.

clue.text: Country has supported married social worker, frankly

explanation.surface: A nation is said to back a married social worker, speaking frankly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Social worker' looks like a job title but is the crossword's insect worker, the ant.

clue.text: Deception present in agreement

clue.text: Director, north European

explanation.walkthrough: 'Director' suggests a film-maker; here it is the fin that steers.
explanation.definitionFit: A Finn is a native of Finland, a nation of northern Europe.

theta is the eighth letter of the Greek alphabet

clue.text: Gelatinous substance appearing green and red, first of all

parts.note: the four words whose initials are taken

clue.text: Curious royal?

explanation.walkthrough: The second reading needs the answer split in two; the question mark flags that wordplay.

clue.text: Once mine, brolly oddly lost

explanation.walkthrough: A brolly is British slang for an umbrella.

clue.text: A foreign national from part of Turkey

parts.note: taken as written

clue.text: Ideology in work device

clue.text: See a sudden movement in vehicle

taken as written

clue.text: Bravery: his more unlikely

clue.text: Just owl, say — one of those in parliament?

parts.note: right means just or fair
an owl is an example of something with wings, a whimsical 'winger'

clue.text: Seeing real changes, don't be specific

indicators.note: the letters undergo changes, being rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

clue.text: Drunk takes in topping activity on slippery surface

clue.text: Mountains extended east beyond capital in Georgia

clue.text: Wood, one by plastic

parts.note: taken as written

taken as written

clue.text: Early stage of development, more by evolving

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

clue.text: I don't believe in Castro!

clue.text: European in England, an Englishman!
